authenticity_review: The image exhibits high perceptual quality (sharp focus, good lighting, no compression artifacts) but suffers from critical semantic failures relative to the prompt. The primary defect is a material hallucination: the prompt specified 'stone', yet the model generated plastic/resin lawn ornaments. Additionally, there is a counting error (4 vs 5). While the rendering is clean, the failure to adhere to core prompt constraints (material and quantity) significantly undermines authenticity as a faithful generation.
key_defects: Count mismatch: Generated 4 flamingos instead of requested 5
Material hallucination: Rendered plastic/resin texture instead of requested stone
Anatomical simplification: Bills lack natural black-to-pink gradient; feet lack webbing detail
